title: Time evolution of nonlinear dynamics on a quantum processor
summary: From fluid flow and transport to collective dynamics, numerical simulation of nonlinear partial differential equations underpins modern scientific computing. Extending this capability to quantum computers remains a longstanding challenge because nonlinear and non-Hermitian evolution is fundamentally incompatible with conventional Hamiltonian-based quantum simulation. Here we experimentally realize the time evolution of nonlinear fluid dynamics on a quantum processor using a hybrid variational framework for the viscous and inviscid Burgers equations.
